feeds.title: the grunge fashion
feeds.description: The Grunge Fashion is a German blog by Nina Wirths. She share her thoughts, write reports about her travels, and gives readers tips on just about everything travel and fashion. Nina has had a passion for Fashion from early age and showcases her ideas and projects through her writings.

feeds.title: LEHAPPY
feeds.description: Le Happy is a personal style blog by Luanna Perez-Garreaud covering fashion, style, beauty, and more. Style Blogger Luanna puts out captivating styled looks and also breaks down the basics of fashion in each post. Learn more about Grunge Fashion, assorted tips and ideas in recent posts.

feeds.title: my dream closet
feeds.description: My Dream Closet is a Grunge Fashion blog posting pictures of the author and other individuals creating and showcasing their own unique style by mixing and matching thrift store finds and incorporating personal touches.

feeds.title: Estelonthemoon
feeds.description: Hello i'm Léa, 22 YO, from Bordeaux in France. In this blog, I will share my looks and fashion inspiration. Read the latest as well as archived stories featuring my outfit choices and some valuable styling advice.

feeds.title: Grunge Trash
feeds.description: Grunge Trash is a Grunge fashion blog exploring the raw aesthetic that defined the 90s subculture. Dive into into the grungy realm and discover the enduring impact of this iconic fashion movement. Stay tuned for a journey into the wild world of Grunge fashion on our Tumblr blog!

feeds.title: Grunge Fashion Blog
feeds.description: Grunge Fashion Blog on Tumblr features an eclectic collection of photography and grunge inspiration. Dive deep and explore aesthetics focusing on casual, mismatched styles, layering, and dark colors.

feeds.title: Grunge Children
feeds.description: My name is Laneikka, and I run this successful little fashion blog called 'Underground Grunge' also known as 'Grunge Children'. A hobby of mine is creating beautiful pieces of modern art. I'm quite a quirky person and one day I hope I can look back on this blog as a fun memory.

feeds.title: Fashion Grunge
feeds.description: Fashion Grunge blog is a celebration of the resurgence and appreciation of the visuals behind the grunge and alternative rock of the '90s. Edited and Co-founded by Lauren M Brown, it also serves as a platform for emerging artists, and designers, and an exploration of many creative passions.

feeds.title: Fashion Blog
feeds.description: Grunge, alternative, hipster, ect. fashion blog. The author shares styling tips and fashion photos inspired by elements of grunge style including oversized and layered clothing, ripped jeans, flannel shirts, and band t-shirts, among others. Explore more about Grunge Fashion and how to make it your own.
